metrics.name: measured_import_kwh
metrics.description: Measured imported energy, kWh. Only VALID, non-estimated readings; dates use Asia/Singapore.
metrics.grain: One aggregate over the selected source records
metrics.time_rule: Reporting timezone: Asia/Singapore; no date filter
metrics.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN meter_readings.quality_status = 'VALID' AND meter_readings.is_estimated = 'false' THEN meter_readings.import_kwh ELSE 0 END)
metrics.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN meter_readings.quality_status = 'VALID' AND meter_readings.is_estimated = 'false'
      THEN meter_readings.import_kwh
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS measured_import_kwh
FROM meter_readings AS meter_readings
LIMIT 201
assumptions: The metric only includes readings that are marked as 'VALID' and not estimated.
